Class Request

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.Request
public class Request extends Object

Title: Request Class

Description: This class represents a help or support request that can later be closed and, if needed, re-opened by a staff user as a new version. The new version keeps a link back to the original closed request through originalClosedRequestId so the system preserves historical context rather than overwriting the original row.

Version:
1.00 2026-04-04 Initial prototype for HW3 request reopen/history support
Author:
Maggie Willis

    • Request

      public Request(String authorUsername, String title, String description, String status, Integer originalClosedRequestId, LocalDateTime createdAt)

      Method: Request(String authorUsername, String title, String description, String status, Integer originalClosedRequestId, LocalDateTime createdAt)

      Description: Constructor used before a Request is inserted into the database. Severity defaults to "Medium" and closeComment defaults to null. Kept for backward compatibility with existing callers.

      Parameters:
      authorUsername - the username associated with this request row
      title - the request title
      description - the request description
      status - the lifecycle status for the request
      originalClosedRequestId - the linked closed request ID for reopened requests, else null
      createdAt - when this request row was created

    • Request

      public Request(String authorUsername, String title, String description, String status, Integer originalClosedRequestId, String severity, LocalDateTime createdAt)

      Method: Request(String authorUsername, String title, String description, String status, Integer originalClosedRequestId, String severity, LocalDateTime createdAt)

      Description: Constructor used before a Request is inserted into the database when a severity level is provided by the submitting staff user.

      Parameters:
      authorUsername - the username associated with this request row
      title - the request title
      description - the request description
      status - the lifecycle status for the request
      originalClosedRequestId - the linked closed request ID for reopened requests, else null
      severity - the urgency level (Low / Medium / High / Critical)
      createdAt - when this request row was created

    • Request

      public Request(int requestId, String authorUsername, String title, String description, String status, Integer originalClosedRequestId, String severity, String closeComment, LocalDateTime createdAt)

      Method: Request(int requestId, String authorUsername, String title, String description, String status, Integer originalClosedRequestId, String severity, String closeComment, LocalDateTime createdAt)

      Description: Full constructor used when loading a Request from the database.

      Parameters:
      requestId - the database-assigned primary key
      authorUsername - the username associated with this request row
      title - the request title
      description - the request description
      status - the lifecycle status for the request
      originalClosedRequestId - the linked original closed request ID, else null
      severity - the urgency level (Low / Medium / High / Critical)
      closeComment - the admin comment recorded when the ticket was closed, else null
      createdAt - when this request row was created
